282931412.description:
Product Overview:
This collection includes multiple vintage writing and calligraphy pen sets with various accessories. It features a Classic Pen Set in a black hard case containing stainless steel pens, colored ink refills, mechanical pencil leads, and additional tips. A wooden calligraphy box by Creswell (model MG030) holds glass dip pens, metal nibs, and an ink bottle. Additional items include a red model Ferrari 1957 pen holder on a wooden base, an Asian calligraphy paint and ink set in its original box, a boxed luxury pen with silver detailing, and a red fountain pen set with cartridges and replacement nibs.

Specifications:
- Classic Pen Set in black hard case
- Stainless steel pens
- Colored ink refills
- Mechanical pencil leads
- Additional pen tips
- Wooden calligraphy box by Creswell, model MG030, approx. 11.5 inches long
- Glass dip pens
- Metal nibs
- Ink bottle
- Red model Ferrari 1957 pen holder on wooden base
- Boxed Asian calligraphy paint and ink set
- Boxed luxury pen with ornate silver detailing
- Red fountain pen set with cartridges and replacement nibs

282922850.description: This lot includes assorted raw mineral and rock specimens weighing approximately 5.50lbs. The collection primarily features quartz and agate geode fragments in shades of brown, tan, white, and yellow. The stones vary in size and texture, with some showing crystalline interiors and rough natural exteriors. One piece is a smooth dark stone with the word 'DREAM' hand-painted in white. All rocks are in their natural, unpolished state. Suitable for collectors, educational purposes, or crafting projects. Sourced from Goodwill.

282684719.description:
Matched pair of split geode halves with white to pale blush crystal clusters lining the hollow interior. The outer shell is rough, tan to yellow-brown stone. Each half measures roughly 5 inches long, and the halves fit together as one geode. Suitable for display as a mineral specimen or decor.

Condition: Pre-owned natural specimen. Rough, dusty outer shell with a few small dark spots on one half. No chips or breaks visible in the crystals.

282302968.description:
Lindenwold's Fine Jewelers
Lot of 24 Loose Gemstone Packets
A vintage collection of 24 individually packaged loose stones from Lindenwold's Fine Jewelers, manufactured in the United States. Dating to the late 20th century, these stones were distributed for custom mounting, jewelry making, and collecting. The collection includes a wide assortment of clear faceted round stones alongside colored faceted stones and cabochons sealed in their original manufacturer packaging.
Includes 24 sealed packets marked Lindenwold's Fine Jewelers
Primarily clear faceted round-cut stones in various graduated sizes
Contains red faceted stones, a pale yellow faceted stone, and dark cabochons
Packaged with 22 black card backs and 2 white card backs, each with hanging tab
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. Packets remain factory sealed. Clear plastic display windows show light surface scuffs and minor handling wear. Stones appear intact with crisp facets and no visible chips or cracks.
Thank you for all of your support!
